_instructions: REQUIRED: Configure your signal sources, ICP voice profiles, and Notion DB IDs. This drives every skill in the Content Team. Update quarterly, or whenever you add/remove a channel.

notion._instructions: Replace with your own Notion database IDs. Leave blank and skills will fall back to local file output only.

signal_sources._instructions: Where Intel Scanner fans out each week. Add or remove sources to match what you actually monitor.

sources.name: Platform performance
sources.scope: [Which analytics source -- GA4, newsletter platform, etc.]

icp_voice_profiles._instructions: Define the two audiences your content speaks to. Used by Blog Writer, Intelligence Brief, and LinkedIn Content for voice differentiation.

practitioner.label: [e.g. 'Individual practitioner / operator']
practitioner.voice_notes: [What this reader cares about, vocabulary, tone]
practitioner.cta_style: [What action you want them to take]

org_buyer.label: [e.g. 'Org-scale decision maker']
org_buyer.voice_notes: [What this reader cares about, vocabulary, tone]
org_buyer.cta_style: [What action you want them to take]

linkedin_personas._instructions: Define each persona LinkedIn Content writes for and which day it posts.

scoring._instructions: Weights used to rank TopicCards and theme proposals. Must sum in a way that makes sense for your priorities.
scoring.proof_gate_threshold: [Minimum score required before a topic is eligible for Intelligence Brief]

output_paths._instructions: Local file output locations, relative to the plugin working directory.
